title: Mini Build: Report Writer
prompt: inventory = {"apples": 12, "bananas": 7} is given. Write summary.csv with a header line name,qty then one line per item (apples,12 then bananas,7). No trailing newline needed on the last line.

tests.name: csv written correctly
tests.code:
with open("summary.csv", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
    _lines = [ _l for _l in _f.read().splitlines() if _l.strip() ]
assert _lines == ["name,qty", "apples,12", "bananas,7"], f"got {_lines}"
tests.hint: write the header, then loop the dict writing f"{name},{qty}\n" per line.
